_doc: Stream E (M2). The event director's list (PLAN §5.2). `director` = the realm rules (ONE big event at a time, sized to who is online and in band, announced 10 minutes ahead, waystone travel to it free while it runs). `realm` = the big events, each on a schedule or a trigger; the province world boss Grimtallow is a fixed-time scheduled event. `zone` = the per-zone event bosses, each running on its own in every zone copy at stream B's event arena (`site` = the arena id in data/zones/<world zone>/placements.json): two waves from the zone's camp mix, then the boss (an encounter script id in data/encounters/). Everyone within autoEnrolMetres joins a temporary event group (PLAN §5.3). Times are real minutes; reward xp = share of a level's XP, gold = multiple of a kill's gold (data/quests/README.md). Every event carries a `blurb` (one or two sentences for the map and the event card: what happens and what to do). Play-test 3 R3: nothing waits on a real-time clock except the world boss's fixed schedule; events start when someone comes near (director.startOn 'near', director.zone), after a short countdown shown as a real number, and are sized for fewer than 5 players. INFO (play-test 5 T12, tools/content-events.mjs): every realm and zone event carries `info` = { name, what (one sentence), objective { kind, text, count, unit } (count = what the server counts: stages = waves + the boss), durationSec (the hard limit: at 0 the event FAILS), onSuccess / onFail (the result line), rewardText (a preview composed from `reward`) }. Never edit `info` by hand: change the words in the tool and re-run it.

size.note: Play-test 3 R3 — fewer than 5 players at a time: boss health x (1 + healthPerPlayer x (enrolled - 1)) up to capPlayers 5 (x2.4 for five), one extra add per addWavePerPlayers enrolled (two for five).

director.pick: Play-test 3 R3 — the owner: 'events should activate when a player goes nearby, not wait in real time; fewer than 5 people will play at a time'. startOn 'near': a realm event starts when a player in its band comes within its radius + nearMetres (and its cooldown is over, and nothing else is running, and nearGapMinutes have passed since the last one), after a countdownSeconds countdown sent as a real time. A FIXED-schedule event (the world boss) is still announced announceMinutes ahead with its real start time (`at`), and also starts on demand when someone in band walks up and it has been quiet quietMinutes. Weighted events never start on their own.
director.credit: By contribution (damage, healing, soaks); loot is personal.

zone._doc: Play-test 3 R3 (stream A js/sim/province.js zoneEventsTick): a zone event waits at its arena, armed, until a player comes within the arena radius + nearMetres; then a countdown of countdownSeconds (sent as a real time, `zoneEvent {kind:'soon', at, inMs}`), then the waves. Everyone walking away during the countdown calls it off. After it ends it rests cooldownMinutes (the map shows when it is ready again: `kind:'cooldown', at`). No real-time schedule.

newcomer._doc: W1 (owner feedback 8): a NEWCOMER is a character under `underLevel` OR one with less than `firstMinutes` of played time. An event with `startOn.clearOfNewcomersM` may not start, nor run its countdown, while a newcomer stands within that many metres of its centre (the settlement for a town event, the arena for a zone event); a countdown already running is called off. tools/content-towns.mjs writes the distances.

raid._doc: W1: a town raid comes in through the gates listed on the event (`raid.gates`), fights the town guards first, and never opens on a newcomer. The numbers and the guards' lines are in data/provinces/guards.json.

chest._doc: W24 (owner feedback 8, report #45): a chest an event leaves (`reward.chest`) is open from the moment the event is won — no kill order, no leftover monster and no missing add can keep it shut — and it stays until everyone who took part has looted it or `lootSec` seconds have passed. The result line ("Won") is only shown once the chest can be opened. Road-event chests follow the same rule: data/provinces/road-events.json `rules.chest`.

zone.announce: Cinderholt's old square is cracking open. The Buried Mayor is calling the council to order.
zone.blurb: The Buried Mayor has dug himself out of Cinderholt's old square. Clear the square, drive off the ghosts round him, then hold the ground shut.
words: Cinderholt's Buried Mayor has dug himself out of the old square.
Clear the three waves that crowd the square, then defeat the Buried Mayor
The Buried Mayor sits down for the last time, and the meeting is over.
The Mayor sinks back into the square, still giving his speech.
zone.where: Ashfall Hollow: in the wilds, about 100 m south of Cinderholt

info.name: The Council Is Called
info.what: Cinderholt's Buried Mayor has dug himself out of the old square.

objective.text: Clear the three waves that crowd the square, then defeat the Buried Mayor

info.onSuccess: The Buried Mayor sits down for the last time, and the meeting is over.
info.onFail: The Mayor sinks back into the square, still giving his speech.
info.rewardText: A rare item or better for everyone who takes part, gold and a good share of experience

zone.name: The High Firing
zone.announce: Smoke is pouring from the high kilns on Kiln Ridge. Kilnwife Orra has started a Slagborn firing.
zone.blurb: Kilnwife Orra is firing the high kilns for a Slagborn rite. Fight through her yard, tip the quench barrels into the kilns, then bring her down.
words: Kilnwife Orra has lit the high kilns for a Slagborn fire rite.
Fight through the three waves in her kiln yard, then defeat Kilnwife Orra
Kilnwife Orra is dead, and the high kilns cool for the first time in years.
The firing ends, the kilns roar on, and Orra goes back to her rites.
zone.where: Kiln Ridge: in the badlands, about 300 m south-west of Kilnhold

zone.name: The Rimwarden Wakes
zone.announce: A great shadow is circling the crater rim. Rimwarden Ysk has come down from the crags.
zone.blurb: Rimwarden Ysk, the glass-winged guardian of the crater, has gone wild. Clear the rim, kill her flock, then ground her.
words: Rimwarden Ysk has come down from the crags to the crater rim.
Clear the three waves on the rim, then defeat Rimwarden Ysk
Rimwarden Ysk falls into the crater, and the rim is quiet.
Ysk lifts off and goes back to circling the crags.
zone.where: The Caldera: in the wilds, about 500 m west of Rim Shrine
